snippet.title: Rusted Sea Trailer
snippet.description:
You must survive the post-apocalyptic ocean of 1963. Buy better gear, fight the SeaBots, and reclaim the deep.

Rusted Sea will be releasing to Steam and itch on March 4th, 2026!

Rusted Sea on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2722780/Rusted_Sea/
Rusted Sea on itch: https://meerkatapult-games.itch.io/rusted-sea
